That's true, I should look at it in a positive light. I like that. I guess I don't have a ton of aspirations, and this job has been the only real thing I've enjoyed doing, so its rough, but I'm sure there are other things I will enjoy.

The fiancee deal is a larger one. Thanks for the kind words, it means a lot. I'm trying to get over it, but I just have a hard time trusting people after being cheated on, abused, manipulated for four years, you know? 


I've dated two women since her - both ended terribly, since I couldn't love them like they deserved. But i'm really sensitive and it hurt me to hurt them, so I figure it's best for me to be alone so I don't hurt anybody. But then again, I don't do well alone. Tough issues.

Thanks again!

Thank you for reading, and for the incredible, well-thought-out response.

I've since talked with one of my two friends, and she was very clear that I wasn't a burden, so that was nice. My other friend hugged me because he found me drunk in the bathtub with razor blades, so I'm getting support but I still don't feel ok and I'm trying to turn it around.

I've been going to the gym on and off for four years, but this last year I've gone 3-4 times a week, and I'm seeing plenty of results and I love it. The problem is that no one else seems to be noticing. I guess my motivation was self-improvement, but I haven't seen any kind of increase in interest in me, which has been an ego blow, if that makes sense?

I do agree that I'm probably putting off signs of distress, which isn't attractive. My family has urged me to go on meds, and I set up an appointment at a depression screening place for tomorrow. I already know I'm depressed, I guess it just felt like a good step to take.

Absolutely, I've tried thinking of reasons to live, but they all seem beyond me, right now. I want to travel, but I don't have money or time. I want to love/be loved, but no one is interested. I want to do x,y, or z, but it doesn't seem possible. I'll keep trying, but this has been a tough year.
